conversation.text:
Police: Is Minghao the same as Xiyuan?
Police: The process of acceptance couldn’t have been that easy, right?
Respondent: There is a waterfront park next to our residential complex. When your police station investigated the area nearby, you should have been there.
Respondent: In the park, there are several weeping willows swaying gently like flowing water, looking very lonely.
Respondent: Last year, when Minghao, Huipin, and I went for a walk in the park, I suddenly felt that Minghao was very much like those weeping willows.
Respondent: Although he seems to sway with the wind, deep inside he is especially profound and firm.
Respondent: For children... actually, for adults like me as well,
Respondent: losing a family member is like experiencing the collapse of one’s world.
Respondent: The process of rebuilding that collapsed world must take a long time.
Respondent: But our Minghao overcame it in his own way.
Respondent: Whenever Minghao goes out, he always holds something in his hand. Have you noticed?
